messages:
Alex C: Quick idea — a tiny 'quickpatch' workflow for hotfixes. Keep it narrow: one-command, shallow approval, automatic rollback window, and a compact release-note template. Sketch below.

Alex C: Example CLI:
```
/deploy quickpatch --service payments --image sha256:abc123 --pin-version --change-window=immediate --notify=oncall
```

Alex C: Release note template suggestion (single-line optional):
```
[quickpatch] payments: fix rounding bug in charge calculation. rolled out to prod with canary=2%. rollback-window=30m. PR: github.com/redwood/payments/pull/456
```

Sam R: Love the ergonomics. Questions: what triggers rollback? auto if error rate > X? or just pause and notify?

Alex C: Thinking auto-rollback if canary error rate > 3% for 5m, otherwise pause and escalate. Default should be conservative. Also expose `--auto-rollback=5m,3%` for teams to tune.

Jen P: Permissions note: quickpatches go to prod, we should require either: a) release role + 1 approver from oncall, or b) an MFA/approve token. Also ensure deploy-bot logs the approving principal to audit.

deploy-bot: Noted. New flag proposals: `--require-approver`, `--approver-token`, `--audit-tag=<ticket>`. Bot will record approver and ticket to deploy log. :white_check_mark:

Maria L: Need a lightweight preflight check hook (latency, error spikes, kv-store health). Suggest adding `--preflight=script.sh` which runs and returns non-zero to abort. Example: `--preflight=tools/preflight/payments-smoke.sh`.

Kevin T: For release notes, keep them one-liners so changelogs stay parsable. We can auto-expand later for release channels. Suggest adding `--changelog-entry=\"[quickpatch] ...\"` and the bot will append to the day's release-notes draft.

Sam R: How about pinning? `--pin-version` should record the pinned model/service sha in release metadata and be reversible via `/deploy unpin`. Avoid accidental pins for rollout experiments.

Alex C: Agreed. Also propose `--dry-run` to print the expansion (traffic split, canary targets, rollback timers) before executing, and `--fast-approve` only for emergency pages (requires oncall).

Jen P: Ops ask: ensure change-window honor (no quickpatch outside 2am-6am unless `--urgent`) and a quick way to notify stakeholder channels: `--notify=#payments-ops,#oncall`.

Alex C: Next steps: I'll draft a tiny RFC + a prototype CLI shim that translates to existing `/deploy` flags and a minimal deploy-bot patch to accept the new flags. Will open a PR and tag this thread. If anyone wants to co-author the preflight script or approval flow, ping me. :construction:

Alex C: PR start: github.com/redwood/release-tools/pull/789 (WIP)

Kevin T: I'll add the release-note parser and a unit test for one-line quickpatch entries.

Maria L: I'll mock a preflight script and attach simple smoke checks.

Sam R: I'll write the default auto-rollback policy and a canary tuning doc excerpt.

deploy-bot: When PR is open, run `/deploy-bot preview 2623456789` to get the new flag map and sample output.

Alex C: Thanks all — aiming to merge minimal safe bits this week. :rocket:
